races.paceDynamic: Ballon Rouge and Regal Knight will set genuine fractions from the start, with both confirmed leaders likely to engage early in this 8-runner field. The honest gallop they create should set up the race perfectly for the hold-up horses, particularly given both pace-setters have recent form showing they fade in the finish. With 5 of the 8 runners employing hold-up tactics and only Sweet Love racing prominently behind the leaders, this becomes a tactical waiting game. The strong pace and subsequent collapse of the front pair will strongly favour the hold-up merchants who can deliver their challenge late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Ballon Rouge and Regal Knight duel early and predictably fade in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The genuine early gallop sets up perfect conditions for the hold-up brigade to sweep past tired leaders. Central Command, Skirt Around, and Steel Fixer are perfectly positioned to capitalise on the pace scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Sweet Love Profits
scenarios.trigger: If Sweet Love can avoid the early battle while staying close enough to strike
scenarios.body: The prominent runner benefits from racing just behind the pace battle without getting involved, allowing her to kick clear as the leaders weaken. Her recent consistency on this surface gives her the tactical edge.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Steady Pace Scenario
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders goes alone early and the other sits off, creating a more sedate gallop
scenarios.body: A slower tempo reduces the kick-back effect and allows the early leader to potentially stay on for longer. Ballon Rouge has the better recent form to capitalize if the pace goes his way.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Pair Sustain
scenarios.trigger: If both Ballon Rouge and Regal Knight show improved stamina and resist the expected fade
scenarios.body: The leaders defy their recent fading tendencies and make it a test of pure speed from the front. This scenario requires both to overcome clear form negatives but the weight relief helps.

races.paceDynamic: Sound Janet is the sole confirmed front runner and will lead unchallenged through moderate early fractions, with King Of Fury and Jujubella tracking prominently but unlikely to pressure aggressively. The pace will be steady rather than testing, allowing the large hold-up contingent including Say What You See, Haveyoumissedme, and Mao Shang Wong to get into comfortable positions. With no pace pressure and a sustainable gallop likely, this race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce a finishing kick from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Comfortable Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Sound Janet leads uncontested with moderate fractions throughout
scenarios.body: The steady tempo allows hold-up horses to position perfectly and unleash superior finishing speed. Quality closers with proven ability at the trip will dominate the finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Capitalize
scenarios.trigger: If King Of Fury or Jujubella apply more pace pressure than expected
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and favours those tracking the leader who can respond when challenged. Horses positioned prominently avoid traffic issues in the straight.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Long Absence Backfires
scenarios.trigger: If the layoff horses Sound Janet and Free Speech show ring-rustiness
scenarios.body: Fresh horses with recent runs gain a significant advantage as the long-absent runners fail to fire. Regularly campaigned horses will benefit from race fitness.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Lightweight Advantage Tells
scenarios.trigger: If the 122lb burdens on Jack Sparowe and Star Cast prove decisive late
scenarios.body: The significant weight advantage allows these horses to quicken when others tire despite moderate recent form. The weight concession overcomes class deficits in a tight finish.

This race shape strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can capitalize on the uncontested early gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If The Cursor maintains his jumping and settles kindly in front

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.label: D

races.paceDynamic: Pressure's On will likely lead unopposed with William Dewhirst and Ey Up Its Jazz the only other potential early pace factors, but both can settle prominently rather than challenge for the lead. This creates a sustainable gallop that won't drain the early leaders, allowing them to maintain their advantage through the 7f trip. The lack of genuine pace pressure means front-runners and prominent racers can dictate terms without being softened up. This race shape clearly favours the early pace, penalising hold-up horses who will face a wall of horses in front and insufficient pace collapse to create gaps.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Pressure's On gets an easy lead with minimal early pressure
scenarios.body: The pace will be steady enough for him to maintain his advantage, with prominent racers also benefiting from the tactical position. Hold-up horses will struggle to make inroads against a field that hasn't been stretched by pace.

races.paceDynamic: Invincible Ruby emerges as the sole confirmed front-runner in this 12-runner handicap, likely to set an uncontested lead with Goal Line and Lord Abama providing minimal early pressure from prominent positions. The majority field comprises hold-up performers including Speeding Bullet, Lion's House, Raft Up, and Caragio, creating a scenario where the pace-setter can dictate terms through moderate fractions. With no genuine speed merchants to apply early pressure, Invincible Ruby can control the tempo and potentially sustain her kick, while the massed ranks of hold-up horses may struggle to make significant ground. This race shape clearly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can position close to the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Invincible Ruby is allowed to bowl along in front without pressure through moderate fractions
scenarios.body: She can control the race tempo and have enough left to repel late challenges from the hold-up brigade. The lack of early pace pressure allows her to conserve energy for the finish while the back-markers face an uphill task.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Overcomes Pace
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses can close the gap as Invincible Ruby's stamina wanes in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The class performers among the hold-up runners can time their challenges perfectly to sweep past a tiring leader. Caragio and Lion's House have the ratings to capitalise on any pace collapse.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Moderate Pace Suits All
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely steady allowing the entire field to remain competitive turning for home
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where the most in-form runners can prevail regardless of running style. Recent winners Raft Up and Bellagio Man can utilise their momentum.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Goal Line or Lord Abama can press Invincible Ruby early and maintain a strong position
scenarios.body: The prominent runners can benefit from tracking the pace without doing the donkey work, positioning perfectly to strike in the final stages. Goal Line's long absence creates uncertainty but his prominent style suits.
